To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. the energy resolution of BESIII EMC is about 3% at 1.0 GeV and about 4% at 1 GeV; 2. we can achieve a 0.5 % absolute energy calibration of BESIII electromagnetic calorimeter; 3. the timing information can be used to veto beam-gass background, which is very useful for physics analyses involving photons with low energy.

1) The energy scale of the EMC is calibrated to a precision of about 0.6% by using 2.3 GeV electron beam energy, 2) the resolution difference between simulation and data is reduced from 10% to 5% and 3) beam-gas background can be efficiently vetoed using the timing information.
